description: EFU General Insurance Limited was incorporated on 2 September 1932 as the Eastern Federal Union Insurance Company and, after life assurance was nationalised in 1972, has operated solely as a general insurer. It describes itself as the largest non-life insurance company in the country and the mother company of the other insurance organisations of EFU Group, writing property, marine and aviation, motor and miscellaneous lines including travel, liability, crop and livestock, personal accident and credit and suretyship, as well as bancassurance. Its head office is EFU House on M.A. Jinnah Road, Karachi.
